description: List the Carbone tags a template uses and return a sample JSON dataset matching its structure. Call it before render_document when you do not know which data a template expects. Pass templateId (a stored template) or template (local path, HTTPS URL or base64). It counts as one render on the account; {t()} tags are not listed.

template.description: A template to inspect, not stored. An absolute local path ("/Users/me/report.docx", "~/report.docx"; a bare name like "report.docx" is read as base64), an HTTPS URL, or the file as base64. Formats: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP, ODG, HTML, XHTML, XML, SVG, IDML, MD, TXT, CSV, RTF, PDF; not the legacy binary DOC, XLS or PPT (re-save them as DOCX, XLSX, PPTX). Exclusive with templateId.

templateId.description: Template ID (its deployed version) or Version ID, from list_templates. Exclusive with template.

name: inspect_template

error.description: Error reported by Carbone while inspecting; only present when there is one.

sample.description: A sample dataset matching the template structure, with placeholder values: { "data": {...}, "complement": {...} }. Pass sample.data as render_document data, and sample.complement as complement.

signatures.description: Signature fields found in the template; only present when there are any.

tags.description: The Carbone tags of the template, as written, e.g. "{d.customer.name}", "{d.items[i].label}", "{c.company}". {t()} translation tags are not listed.

title: Inspect Template
